newsitem.title: USA: US spot prods down ahead of close, diffs steady.
newsitem.headline: US spot prods down ahead of close, diffs steady.

text.p: U.S. spot refined product prices remained weaker Friday, though little movement in the differentials was noted.

Bearish inventory data released late Thursday from the American Petroluem Institute (API) and the Energy Information Administration (EIA) pressured the NYMEX lower, though nearby contracts appeared to be holding support levels.
Players said activity in the market remained subdued, with many participants out following the New Year's Day holiday on Wednesday. Trading is expected to return to normal levels next week.
New York Harbor (NYH) prompt No. 2 oil diffs slipped slightly, with offers at 0.40 cents over the screen, and No. 2 for January 14th delivery changed hands at that level, traders said.
Activity at the U.S. Gulf (USG) was thin, and traders said gasoline appeared to be the main focus.
USG conventional unleaded M4 for delivery in the back 2nd cycle on the Colonial Pipeline was offered at 2.85 cents under the screen.
Very little conventional was available for the 1st cycle, though 3rd cycle M4 changed hands at 3.25 cents under NYMEX.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk 1 212 859 1626
